notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Harabaz Druid.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Harabaz Druid.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Harabaz Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Harabaz Druid.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Harabaz Druid from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.
